verdict.rationale: Parsec documents its own multi-display capability, "Multi-monitor streaming (Up to 3)" and virtual monitors, so it does handle multi-display hosts. Nothing in the evidence shows choosing one specific monitor, window, or app, or switching views mid-session. The host's control over which apps guests may see is a guest-permission feature, not viewer-side selection, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented per-monitor selection and mid-session switching, window/app-level streaming, hands-on or independent corroboration.
